en.headline: Former prison officer jailed three years for assaulting inmate
en.dek: Tam Lik-chung was sentenced at the District Court after admitting he ordered and took part in an attack on a prisoner at Pik Uk Correctional Institution in December 2023.
body: A former Correctional Services Department assistant officer has been jailed for three years for wounding an inmate with intent to cause grievous bodily harm.

District Court Judge Frankie Yiu Fun-che sentenced Tam Lik-chung on Monday. The court heard that in December 2023 at Pik Uk Prison, after the victim threw baby powder on him during a bingo game, Tam ordered the man to a staircase, demanded he remove his trousers and repeatedly thrust a wooden stick into his rectum through his underwear. The victim required surgery and temporarily a stoma bag.

Tam also pleaded guilty to perverting the course of justice by telling the victim to claim he had scratched himself. The judge said Tam’s judgment was clouded by power and the assault amounted to an abuse of authority. Three inmates involved received sentences of between four and six months.

zh.headline: 前懲教助理員襲擊在囚人士判囚三年
zh.dek: 譚力中承認於2023年12月在壁屋懲教所下令及參與襲擊一名在囚人士，區域法院周一判處監禁三年。
body: 一名前懲教署助理員因意圖造成身體嚴重傷害而傷害在囚人士，被判監禁三年。
區域法院法官姚勳智周一判處譚力中。案情指2023年12月在壁屋懲教所，事主於玩賓果時向他撒爽身粉後，譚力中着事主到樓梯，要求他脫褲，再以木棍隔着內褲多次插入其直腸。事主需接受手術，一度使用造口袋。
譚力中亦承認妨礙司法公正，指使事主謊稱自己刮傷。法官指他權力蒙蔽判斷，屬濫用職權。三名參與的在囚人士分別判囚四至六個月。
